meta.name: Ensure SES Configuration Set enforces TLS usage
meta.description: Ensure SES Configuration Set enforces TLS usage
meta.remediation: Set delivery_options { tls_policy = "Require" } on every aws_ses_configuration_set.

evaluators.description: The single delivery_options block of aws_ses_configuration_set must carry tls_policy = 'Require'. delivery_options is a list in the plan, hence the indexed path delivery_options.0.tls_policy; an absent or empty block is a severity-2 miss and fails at error_tolerance 1.
